translations.web: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
translations.bsb: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises!
translations.kjv: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
